title: CEP 2023: le ministre Karimou lance un appel pour l'inscription des enseignants et élèves sur educmaster.bj
why_not: The minister's letter of 14 March 2023 ordering every public and private school to register nursery and CI-CM1 pupils on emp.educmaster.bj by 14 April 2023; held rows BEN-004 to BEN-006 already state school-entered enrolment on EDUCMASTER over three years, and it gives no count of schools and nothing on plan or finance.
